title: Sustainable Beauty Awards 2026: Guerlain, Wella and Unilever among the winners
summary: The winners of the 2026 Sustainable Beauty Awards were announced in Paris on 27 October, recognising innovations in sustainable beauty products, ingredients, packaging and responsible sourcing. Organised by Ecovia Intelligence, the awards presented Gold and Silver distinctions across six categories. In the New Sustainable Product category, Wella won Gold for Supernatural Color, a hair colour range containing over 90% ingredients of natural origin, with packaging designed for recyclability.... - Industry buzz

ingredients.name: Regenyl
ingredients.quote: Kensing took Gold in the Sustainable Ingredient category for Regenyl, a 100% upcycled glycolipid biosurfactant

ingredients.name: vitamin E
ingredients.quote: Regenyl, a 100% upcycled glycolipid biosurfactant produced through microbial fermentation using by-products from its vitamin E manufacturing process.

ingredients.name: Regenerative Nilotica Shea
ingredients.quote: Amika received Silver for its Regenerative Nilotica Shea, sourced through a partnership with a women-led supplier in Uganda.

ingredients.name: jasmine
ingredients.quote: The Sustainability Pioneer (Raw Materials) award recognised Egyptian company Hashem Brothers for its ethical jasmine sourcing and responsible procurement programmes

ingredients.name: Jatamansi
ingredients.quote: Primavera Life received Silver for its Jatamansi Project in Bhutan, combining biodiversity conservation with community development.

ingredients.name: Ocean Pure HA™
ingredients.quote: Deep Blue BioTech won Silver for Ocean Pure HA™, produced using photosynthetic biomanufacturing.
